title: Endpoint
description: A provider someone else runs, reached with your key: a cloud provider such as OpenRouter (design 0016 §4). Its key is kept with the secrets (CLANK_HOME/secrets/endpoint/<id>/key), never in this file.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

adapter.description: The endpoint adapter that speaks to it, such as openrouter.
adapter.title: Adapter

url.description: Its API's base URL; for a cloud provider the adapter's own, so the key never goes elsewhere.
url.title: Address

auth.description: bearer: the key in an Authorization header; none: no key.
auth.title: Key sent as

reach.description: Where what it is sent goes: this-machine, my-servers, or cloud (a company's API).
reach.title: Reach

options.description: The adapter's own options, such as OpenRouter's data_collection (deny: only providers that keep no data) and zdr (only zero-data-retention providers).
options.title: Provider options

agreed.description: When you agreed that prompts and the files and command output the agent reads go to it; empty: not agreed, and nothing loads from it.
agreed.title: Agreed

timeout_seconds.description: The longest the gateway waits for the next piece of an answer, in seconds.
timeout_seconds.title: Read timeout
